title: Doorway effect: your brain purges memories at doors
caption:
You walk in... and instantly forget why. Sound familiar?
Our guy marches to the kitchen for one important thing, then just stands there: total blank.
It's the doorway effect: a door acts as an event boundary, so your brain files the current plan away and clears the why from memory.
What did you last forget the second you stepped into a room?
Save this before your brain purges it too - then share it with a forgetful friend.
